title: Nurse-created Code Red sets the triage nurse as the admission's primary doctor
actual: Fresh Code Red created as demo.triage returns primary_doctor_id 9 and primary_doctor_name Nadia (Triage Nurse). The same incorrect clinician attribution persists when a doctor rereads the admission. The triage account is allowed to create a Code Red, but creating it does not make the nurse the treating doctor.
expected: Keep the actual treating-doctor attribution accurate: leave it unassigned until a clinician is designated, or apply the documented clinician assignment rule. Please clarify the supported handover/assignment API if one exists. Do not require the frontend to invent a doctor or silently replace the server's primary_doctor_name. doctor_inpatients presents the admission's actual treating doctor.
steps: On current DEV, create own synthetic General ward9 and beds38/39. Scenario opd.new_patient_paid run bdaba7 creates patient8. As demo.triage POST /admissions/code-red with patient_id8,ward_id9,ward_type:null,needs_ot:false and DEMO note. GET /admissions/9 as demo.doctor; compare the primary_doctor fields with the triage account and nurse lookup.
